svg.text: THE COLLECTIVE · PLATE A-1 · ATOMIC WORKFLOW BLOCK, 5 CONNECTORS & OPERATOR COMMAND
THE WORKFLOW BLOCK — REUSABLE CAPABILITY, HUMAN COMMAND
A1 · INTERLOCKING WORKFLOW BLOCK WITH OPERATOR COMMAND, HARA HOST & 4-PIN GOVERNANCE CHIP
BOUNDED CAPABILITY UNIT · OPERATOR IN COMMAND (HARA HOST) · CONNECTS PEOPLE, AGENTS, TOOLS & SYSTEMS
WHAT EVERY WORKFLOW BLOCK DOES (4 CORE CAPABILITIES)
Runs deterministic code and checks on the hot path while keeping
a named human in command of rules and exceptions.
Records durable transaction state, lineage receipts, and scoped
operating memory without leaking private data.
Links operator workspaces, living SOPs, peer blocks, and
systems of record through governed interfaces.
Embeds policy boundaries, independent verification, audit receipts, and
named human approval into every block.
5 SELECTIVE INTERFACES (SLACKLINE · A2A · MCP · CLI · API)
Headless ERP, CRM, WMS, MES & databases.
Each block mounts only the interfaces required for its bounded job.
A2 · ROTATED 3D PERSPECTIVE & THREE OPERATING SPEEDS
Approved code runs on the hot path.
ARCHITECTURAL PRINCIPLE: EXECUTION & JUDGMENT NEVER BLOCK EACH OTHER.
Code handles the transaction. Intelligence and human authority handle the decision.
A3 · OPERATOR IN COMMAND · HARA RUNTIME HOST
HUMAN AUTHORITY AT THE CENTER OF EVERY BLOCK:
Automation executes standard work; the named operator owns judgment and approval.
A4 · 4-PIN GOVERNANCE CHIP — CONTROLS, REVIEW, EVIDENCE & APPROVAL
Named human authority approves releases, exceptions, and material actions.
Tamper-evident execution receipts with end-to-end data and decision lineage.
Runtime monitoring and independent verification (builders never grade their own work).
Explicit read/write, authority, and policy boundaries enforced before execution.
Every block carries controls, independent review, audit evidence, and human sign-off.
The Workflow Block — Reusable Capability, Human Command
Bounded Unit of Work · Operator in Command · HARA Runtime Host · 4-Pin Governance Chip
5 Selective Interfaces (Slackline · A2A · MCP · CLI · API) · 4-Pin Governance
Three Operating Speeds: Execute · Monitor · Review | Human Authority in Command
